test: M12 fix round, measurement B: the GPU profiler in Safari on a scene with transparents, so that the transparent sort runs live
label: Apple M2 Pro / Metal, Safari 27.0.1

env.head: 11f83da
env.browser: Safari 27.0.1 (22625.1.29.11.28), macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), MacBook Pro Mac14,9, Apple M2 Pro
env.driver: safaridriver 27.0.1 (-p 4444), W3C WebDriver from node fetch: POST /session, POST /window/rect 1200x741, POST /url, POST /execute/async (script timeout 180000 ms); session deleted and safaridriver stopped at the end
env.window: Safari frontmost (open -a Safari before each run, checked with lsappinfo), document visible for the whole run, CSS inner 1200x689, dpr 2, rAF 60 Hz
env.power: AC Power (pmset -g batt), 65 W from the Apple 67W USB-C adapter (pmset -g adapter), battery 100% charged, lowpowermode 0, caffeinate -dimsu running; AC Power again after each run
env.chromeIdle: both Chrome MCP servers had their only page on about:blank before the runs (chrome-devtools-gpu page 18, chrome-devtools page 2); not touched afterwards
env.devServer: vite on :5173 (pid 60862), serving the main checkout at 11f83da, COOP same-origin + COEP require-corp
env.shaderCache: not cold: the same WebKit GPU process (alive since 07:21, pid 46752) compiled the same shaders during M12 the same morning; neither measurement times a compilation
env.guard: M12's post-navigation guard (m12-tabs-B.json `guard`): console capture into window.__cap, the Vite ping blocked, visibility log
env.page: http://localhost:5173/?mode=B&bench (no section: an empty world), loaded at 09:27:15Z; run from 09:27:24Z to 09:27:49Z
env.canvas: engine.resize(1920, 1080) by the script, as in the bench; dpr 2

method: The M8 bench scene (docs/plans/assets/2026-09-27-transparent-sort-bench.js at HEAD: its constants, helpers, mulberry32 seeded n * 2 and spawn loop, copied) with N = 10 000 2D quads, .transparent(), 16x16 px, depth 'same', target 1920x1080, lighting off. The bench itself measures one 120-frame window and destroys its quads, so the script keeps them and measures three windows: `first`, the first 120 valid frames after the page's first enableGpuProfiling() (which builds the GpuProfiler: a fresh query set); `steady`, then 1200 rAF frames with no reset; `reset`, disableGpuProfiling(); enableGpuProfiling() in one turn (same query set, stamp history forgotten) and the first 120 valid frames after it. A temporary wrapper on the live profiler instance (own properties on consume and history.record, calling the originals; deleted at the end, `wrapperRemoved`) logs every consumed frame of `first` and `reset`: pairs, stamps, kept or discarded. The engine code does not change. `rows` holds one line per logged frame, `rawFirstFrames` the full stamps of the first two, `lastFrameBeforeReset` those of the last frame consumed before the reset.

readings.entries: getGpuTimings() has transparent-sort/gather, /upsweep, /scan and /scatter in all three windows, 120 samples each, next to cull, forward and fxaa-tonemap

timestampGrid.what: every lastMs, every steady span and every stamp of the five saved frames as a count of 41.667 ns (24 MHz) ticks; the stamps are whole nanoseconds, so a whole tick count shows up rounded to the nanosecond

readings.reading: No discard of any reason (stale 0) in 1200 steady frames with the profiler's persistent query set, and 0 skipped. In the two first windows (after the page's first enable, i.e. a fresh query set, and after a reset; on their first frame the history cannot flag a raced pair) no worked pair repeats the previous consumed frame at its index, none is zero or reversed, and every worked pair lies within 2.94 ms of its frame's median beginning or end, against a frame period of 16.7 ms: no raced pair in these runs. Frame 0 of the fresh query set is one coherent timeline: cull, then the 22 sort passes back to back (gaps of 0.5-0.9 us), the last one ending 4 us before forward begins, then forward and fxaa-tonemap.

first.label: first 120 valid frames after the first enableGpuProfiling() (fresh profiler, fresh query set)

steady.label: 1200 rAF frames right after the first window, no reset

reset.label: first 120 valid frames after disableGpuProfiling(); enableGpuProfiling() (reset: same query set, history forgotten)

summary.firstFrameComparedWith: the last frame consumed before the reset (frames in flight at the reset are never consumed)
